clauses.clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield.
clauses.evidence: trace [stimulus: turns pass ... your next upkeep]: trigger [0] fires once, 'ask may: [fire, skip]' then 'ask choose: [0, 1, 2]' (both / library / graveyard); no Shrine on the probe board, so nothing is found. Tree: TurnPhaseEvent(UPKEEP, actor YOU), OptionalEffect(Choose(...)), SEARCH TYPE_EQ 'Shrine' (type-line word match, quantity.py:818-832, subtypes included) to your BATTLEFIELD. Packs: graveyard option fetches the Shrine under your control (..._from_graveyard_no_shuffle PASS), library option fetches it (..._from_library PASS), skip leaves it (..._skip_does_nothing PASS).
clauses.issue: engine-limit: the find can never fail when a Shrine is present (CR 701.23b allows failing in the library). Selectors are ONE_OF where today's compiler writes CHOOSE (similar [B2a-sanctum-of-all]); both are exactly-one QConst(1) picks, and BACKLOG 'Weaker than printed' records that every tutor except Alpine Houndmaster still finds when it can. The live tree behaves the same (a fail-to-find pack fails, kept out of the verdict). Weaker, not stronger.

clauses.clause: If you search your library this way, shuffle.
clauses.evidence: tree: SHUFFLE(your library) closes options 0 and 1 only; option 2 (graveyard only) has none, matching the text; a shuffle is not visible in the trace. Packs: graveyard-only fetch and skip keep the library order exactly (PASS); library fetch leaves the shuffled remainder (set asserted with '*', PASS)

clauses.clause: If an ability of another Shrine you control triggers while you control six or more Shrines, that ability triggers an additional time.
clauses.evidence: no other Shrine on the probe board. Tree [1] AbilityTriggerEvent(FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, SUBTYPE_EQ Shrine, FNot(IS_SOURCE))), condition CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 6 Shrines, TRIGGER_ADDITIONAL 1: identical to canonical [B5b-sanctum-all-extra-trigger]. Packs: six Shrines make Sanctum of Stone Fangs (X = 6) trigger twice, 32/8 (PASS); five Shrines plus an opponent's Shrine: once, 25/15 (PASS); Sanctum of All's own upkeep trigger is not doubled (PASS); the opponent's Stone Fangs is not doubled, 19/21 (PASS) All packs cited here also PASS when run on this packet's own tree (runpack --card <card> --draft <the packet's tree>).
